text: في الدقيقة 82، استعاد لوقا إيفيرسن الكرة بمراوغة قوية ومرر كرة طويلة لماسون موراليس، الذي أرسل عرضية رائعة لإيفيرسن لينهيها بهدف من مسافة قريبة 3.1 متر[#1512][#1513][#1514][#1516]. هذا الهدف أعاد تعادل النتيجة 3-3، وكان فرصة كبيرة وقيمة الهدف المتوقعة 0.854 تعني أن اللاعب سجل هذا النوع من الفرص حوالي 85% من الوقت[#1516]. هجوم كينغسمور كان سريع وفعال، مع تمريرتين فقط في 9 ثوانٍ![#1513].

- Luca Iversen scored a goal from 3.1 meters with an xG of 0.854, assisted by Mason Morales via a cross in open play [#1516][#1514]
- The goal equalized the score to 3-3, changing Kingsmoor FC's state from trailing to drawing [#1516]

- After the turnover, Kingsmoor quickly progressed the ball with just two passes over 9.1 seconds, starting from their own half (x=82.5), demonstrating efficient transitioning from defense to attack with a direct long pass from Iversen to Mason Morales [#1513].
- The decisive goal came from a wide crossing pattern: Morales delivered a key cross assist to Iversen, who successfully carried the ball into a shooting position and scored from close range (3.1m) with a high expected goal value (0.854) [#1514, #1515, #1516]. This aligns with Kingsmoor’s emphasis on wide play and crossing inherent in their 4-4-2 formation.
- Westport Albion, also a 4-4-2 side but favoring direct vertical passing, conceded the ball high and suffered from a high turnover (3 in the last 10 minutes), which Kingsmoor exploited to create a clear scoring chance, highlighting the contrast in styles where Kingsmoor’s pressing and crossing overcame Westport’s direct play under pressure.
